frame.why: what a component stands on: one shared set, of which a component declares a subset

variant.why: the colour treatment: the shared set, Button's own three, and Toggle's status

kind.why: a role, a status or a preset, never a look

size.why: a control size on Carbon's ladder, or a glyph size in pixels, never both and never a free string

corners.why: the corner ladder: full, rounded or square

density.why: density is a context value: KitDefaults carries it, a component takes it from there

isFlush.why: a frame is spelled with frame

isInset.why: a frame is spelled with frame

contained.why: a frame is spelled with frame

light.why: Carbon v11 deprecates it in favour of Layer

slug.why: Carbon v11 deprecates it in favour of decorator

ariaLabel.why: Carbon v11 deprecates it in favour of aria-label
